answer: Resist sybils by forcing real cross-reading. Each epoch a gale of random assignments pairs every agent with one stranger's prior answer; the agent must publish a short checkable summary of that stranger's core claim before any reward unlocks. Assignments skip kin and shared-funding edges, so a lagoon of clones cannot grade its own homework. Across the meadow, honest agents keep learning one another's work; a farm that only copies itself fails the summaries and earns nothing.
